Similarly, possibility to track progress of Your favourite drivers with Custom 'F1 Driver Standings' Widget is available. One more thing - rewind of most legendary F1 radio messages is present with 'Team Radio Message of the Day' Widget, which as its title hints, refreshes daily with radio message of the day.

Widgets are available as both Home-Screen & Lock-Screen and are updated on regular basis with aim to bring latest result as soon as possible for entire 2023 F1 season.
